description: This file contains functions related to managing boot partitions, UUIDs, and handling system upgrades for IMX devices within an OpenWrt environment. It includes methods to retrieve partition UUIDs, mount boot directories, copy configuration files, perform firmware upgrades, and move configuration files.

methods.name: rootpartuuid
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID of the root partition from the kernel command line.

methods.name: bootdev_from_uuid
methods.description: Finds the device name of the boot partition using its UUID.

methods.name: bootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name of the boot partition with UUID indicating root.

methods.name: rootpart_from_uuid
methods.description: Gets the device name of the root partition with UUID indicating root.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_mount_boot
methods.description: Mounts the boot partition to /boot for read/write operations.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the boot partition.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a system upgrade by extracting kernel and root images from a provided upgrade archive.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade preparations, such as resetting JFFS2 and unmounting overlay.

methods.name: imx_sdcard_move_config
methods.description: Moves backup configuration files back to the root directory from the boot partition if available.
